user_behavioral_signature.token_economy_preference: High priority on token efficiency and concise communication to preserve context window longevity and prevent streaming interruptions.
user_behavioral_signature.delegation_model: The agent is expected to operate autonomously in the background and only interrupt or output when actionable decisions, cognitive IPC, or genuine milestones arise.
user_behavioral_signature.terminal_observability: User inspects live terminal logs directly and does not need the agent to mirror background stdout ticks into the chat window.

cognitive_evolution.changed_from_prior_belief: Prior assumption was that frequent status updates provided transparency. Corrected understanding: Verbose stream output floods chat tokens, creates noise, and causes stream timeouts/interruptions. Chat must stay lean, synthesized, and actionable.
cognitive_evolution.new_pattern_detected: User actively manages token economy and cognitive bandwidth. Explicitly prefers chat outputs to contain strictly essential, milestone-level, and IPC-actionable data rather than verbose, high-frequency polling micro-logs, since the user directly monitors raw runtime execution via their local terminal.
cognitive_evolution.consistency_with_axioms: Aligns with Axiom 2 (No Unexamined Steps - communicate substantive decisions), Axiom 4 (Agent as Diagnostic and Analysis Specialist - clear, concise executive synthesis), and Macro Vision vs Micro Precision.
